notes: Strongest unit in the batch on item design. Every distractor carries a real, named misreading and each is instructive: q1 over-hedge vs quantifier-upgrade ('almost nothing alive' -> 'bare of living root') vs outside knowledge (severed anchor roots); q2 fabricated mechanism from passage furniture, hedged actor-swap onto the water-main street, cautious-sounding contradiction of 'The five had one thing in common'; q3 fabricated trend, the inference paragraph 5 exists to block, and the paragraph-1 folk theory; q4 attribution swap, polarity-inverted concessive twin, neutral-reporter misread; q5 detail-as-main, rival umbrella, title-plausible theme. Law 10 is genuinely broken across the unit, not just declared: key strict-longest 0/5; pick-the-qualified selects the key 1/5 (q4) and hedged/cautious options are WRONG on q2 (B,C), q3 (C) and q4 (C), so the inverse heuristic fails too; q2 is a clean worked example of RULE 13 (key = confident specific claim, distractor over-hedges). Main-idea item sits at block edge (pos 5) per blueprint; family mix and BrE variety hold. FIX 1 (rationale accuracy, teaching payload): q1 says of A 'the hedge is about degree, not location'. That is not right - Askerholt's quote is 'Most of the force, WE THINK, is generated within a hand's width of the stone', and 'we think' is an epistemic hedge on the whole proposition, location included. The true rebuttal of A is that her group lifted the flags on nineteen streets and MAPPED every root, so the location is settled by the survey, not by the quote. Rewrite that clause; no option/key/stem touched, no re-gate. FIX 2 (calibration honesty): the NOTES restate adversarial blind floors for q5 (1-in-2), q3 and q2/q4 (1-in-4 on form) but state NO floor for q1 - the one question whose carried G-STEM r2 flag identifies a cross-question conceptual bridge (q4's option 'She agrees with Askerholt that the worry was overdone' presupposes Askerholt holds a definite position, which strips q1-A passage-blind, leaving B/C). Declare q1 explicitly at 1-in-2, which is the tolerated max and therefore still inside policy. Related NOTE: the RULE 11 sweep is run on lexical lemmas, and this bridge is conceptual, so the sweep cannot see it - see batch-level note. Carried G-STEM r2 flags otherwise honestly within the calibration policy: all five are classed 'narrowing 4->2' (never a collapse to one), floors are stated per question and were restated after round 3, and on q2 the blind pick (B) MISSES the key, so the cautious-form heuristic actively misfires.

Fact-checked every collocation claim in all five rationales against real English; all true, which is the Batch-1 failure mode this stage exists to catch and it is clean here. Gap 1 'takes its toll on' is the only assembly - 'takes its cost/price on' have no reading and 'take charge' cannot take the possessive or govern 'on', exactly as the rationale says. Gap 3 is the best-engineered item in the batch: each distractor completes a DIFFERENT real idiom with one of the frame's other words while failing the whole noun phrase - 'hold the floor' (real, parliamentary), 'hold the field' (real, military), 'moral high horse' (informally attested but takes get on/off, never hold) - so the gap rewards parsing the full 'the moral high ___' unit rather than pairing the gap word with 'hold'. Gap 5's design note (rejecting 'hits' because 'hit the right balance' is colloquially attested and would have made a second defensible key) is exactly the discipline law 4 asks for. Gap 2 is a true polarity item ('The tone is light, BUT nobody misreads it; BENEATH the sponge...') and gap 4 is a genuine connective item whose key doubles as the classic Swedish false friend (eventuellt = possibly), so it teaches a real, named L1 interference error rather than just testing vocabulary. POS-uniform and shape-matched in every gap (nouns / -ed adjectives / nouns / -ly adverbs / verbs); key letters CDABC with a logged randomisation and no collision with any shipped cloze key string; hedging is not in play on gaps 1/3/5 and the one cautious option (gap 4 'Presumably') is a distractor, so the qualified heuristic scores 0/5. SURVIVED_CLEAN with no G-STEM or G-DISTRACTOR flag, so no blind floor is owed. Forward OBSERVATION only, not a defect: three of five gaps (1, 3, 5) are fixed-idiom completions solvable from their own six-word frame with zero passage reading, leaving 2/5 that genuinely require upstream context. This is inside the blueprint ('>=1 collocation, >=1 polarity, >=1 connective; remaining free') and matches the corpus's collocation-dominant anatomy, so nothing to change here - but a unit that lands 3/5 context-dependent would measure reading rather than lexical stock, worth aiming at in batch19.

Pedagogically the sharpest single-question item in the batch, and the mechanism direction is the reason: the key is counterintuitive (the protective mortar is what rotted the timbers), so lay priors point at A (torching sheltered the battens) and B (mortar is what holds tiles on) and away from the key - the distractors are not merely wrong, they are the two misconceptions a student actually arrives with. A additionally lifts 'shelter' from the final sentence where FELT, not torching, does the sheltering (surface_word_match on a reversed mechanism); B is refuted by ordering as well as by attribution (the tiles hang from nibs, every fourth course nailed, and the torching 'went on AFTER the tiles were hung'); C is a clean scope upgrade of the enumerated wind-ingress job. Rationale is the best-evidenced in the batch - the mechanism_verification_note logs a real pre-drafting source check (Wienerberger technical note; SPAB / buildingconservation on nib-hung plain tiles and every-fourth-course nailing; felt-under-battens geometry) and every directional claim in the passage maps onto it, so the teaching payload is factually sound. Law 10/13 clean: key D flat and tied-shortest (A 16 / B 16 / C 15 / D 15, ratio 1.07), the one hedged option (A 'usually') is wrong. FIX (calibration honesty, metadata only): the declared adversarial blind floor in gen-elf-short-1.NOTES.md is 'no better than 1-in-4', but the carried G-STEM finding shows C strips on form alone before any domain knowledge (it is the only unrestricted claim - 'the year round', 'whatever the weather drove against the roof'), so the honest floor is 1-in-3. Restate it. 1-in-3 remains comfortably inside the <=1-in-2 policy, so this is an accuracy fix, not a blocker. OPTIONAL fix (option edit, would need G-KEY/G-DISTRACTOR re-gate): bound C to a season or a condition so it is not the sole unrestricted option - note that C carries NO token from the completed M-FORM absolutizer list, so this is precisely the sweeping-shape residue rule 13 asks G-STEM to hunt by hand. The other carried finding (a building-conservation specialist answers D textblind) is within tolerance for the HP target population: torching is not lay knowledge for a Swedish 18-year-old, and the generator's own design puts lay priors on the wrong options.

Good TYPE-002 inference design: the passage lays down four dated document facts and explicitly withholds the connection ('The wardens' minutes record the new lettings without a word of explanation'), so the reader must build the reading rather than retrieve it, and the 1861 front-box rise is deliberate loose residue that fits the key without pointing at it. Distractors carry real, named misreadings: A is the Victorian church-room-shortage narrative imported from outside knowledge and foreclosed by the vacancy marks plus the free benches; C is a two-step leap (cheap, therefore for the poor) about takers the text never discusses, and pew 9's eighteen-shilling class points the other way; D is the law-11-compliant detail-as-main - the passage's own figure with the UNIT bent (two shillings bought a sitting 'apiece', not a box). Law 10/13 handled well: key B is a flat causal assertion and BOTH cautious-sounding options (A 'mainly', C 'chiefly') are wrong, so pick-the-qualified selects a distractor 1/1; key is second-shortest (A 15 / B 16 / C 18 / D 17, ratio 1.20). FIX 1 (rationale accuracy - two unsupported factual claims in the teaching payload): the rationale asserts 'the benches at the door were free the whole time' and 'the free benches stayed in the plan throughout'. The passage establishes free west-door benches only in the 1848 plan and says nothing about later years; 'throughout' / 'the whole time' are invented. The rebuttal of A and C survives intact if reworded to 'the 1848 plan records free benches at the west door, and nothing in the passage reports their removal' - same force, no fabricated fact. Rationale-only, no re-gate. FIX 2 (calibration honesty): this unit carries two G-STEM majors but declares NO adversarial blind floor anywhere - not in generator_meta, not in gen-elf-short-2.NOTES.md. It is the only flagged unit in the batch with no floor statement at all, so condition (a) of the calibration policy is unmet on its face. State it: D strips on shape and topic (a bare price datum about whole boxes under a stem asking what can be CONCLUDED about single sittings), giving an honest floor of 1-in-3 for the target population - inside policy, but it has to be written down. NOTE: the gate's second finding (nineteenth-century pew-rent economics picks B textblind) is within tolerance - that is frontier-model knowledge, not HP-candidate knowledge. NOTE: D's strippability also costs it pedagogical value; it teaches only a unit-vs-price skim error and cannot tempt a solver who reads the stem.

HOLD on a live construct-validity defect at q3, with q4 compounding it. Much of this unit is excellent - fleet-repair-2 did real work, the q1 rebuild is a model of law 1 (all three distractors are claims a knowledgeable-but-textblind reader rates plausible: exothermic ignition, pit maturation, hot mixing with sand - each a REAL lime practice, wrong only against this text), the q4 key is a genuine two-fact inference (a scatter of remains is a succession, not a census), keys spread A/D/B/C, key strict-longest 0/4, and the rule-11 lemma audit is thorough. But: Q3 IS GAMEABLE WITHOUT READING. On a 'Vilket påstående överensstämmer bäst med texten?' stem, key B ('Kalkbränningen var en viktig binäring som till sist konkurrerades ut') is the only whole-arc, self-limiting summary in the set, while A ('i första hand'), C (farmers setting farming aside) and D (monocausal exhaustion of the limestone) each stake one strong single claim. Option SHAPE alone - summary vs specific claim - lands on the key with no passage and no domain knowledge; that is exactly the correlation law 10 exists to break, and G-STEM r2 said so and left an explicit repair recommendation ('consider softening A/C/D so the moderation tell does not do the work') which was never actioned. The unit's generator_meta.hedge_map discharges law 10 as 'Välj det garderade träffar nyckeln i 0 av 4 frågor', but that is measured on LEXICAL hedge tokens only (no 'ofta'/'kan'/absolutizers anywhere in the unit); it does not test the claim-strength axis the gate used, so it is not a valid discharge for q3. Q4 compounds: G-STEM r2 reports 'the field narrows to C passage-blind' because only C is a conclusion a scatter of undated remains could license, and that is general evidential literacy, not lime expertise. CALIBRATION: the declared floors in gen-las-long.NOTES.md ('No question better than 1-in-2 blind'; Q3 ~1-in-2, Q4 ~1-in-3) were written at generation and never reconciled with the post-repair G-STEM r2 record, in which the blind pick is the KEY on all four questions (A soft, D, B, C) and the field collapses to one option on q3 and q4. A stale floor contradicted by the gate's own record does not satisfy condition (a) of the calibration policy, and restating it honestly would put q3/q4 above the 1-in-2 ceiling - which is why the fix cannot be metadata-only. Secondary: this is the only unit whose floor lives solely in NOTES.md and never in the shipped generator_meta, unlike all three siblings. REQUIRED FIX (option edits, key and key letter untouched, needs G-KEY + G-DISTRACTOR + G-STEM re-gate): recast at least one q3 distractor as a measured, two-part, whole-arc summary that is checkably wrong against the text - e.g. rebuild D as a summary-shaped wrong cause ('...en binäring som dog ut när kalkstenen i trakten tog slut') so B is not the sole summary; and on q4 give at least one of A/B/D an evidential shape that a scatter of remains could plausibly license, so C is not the only defensible conclusion on form. ALSO CARRIED (G-SPRÅK minors, not mine to relitigate but they sit in KEY options where the sentence should be the cleanest on the sheet): q2 key 'gick samman kring en gemensam ugn' (collocation is 'gå samman om'; pleonasm samman/gemensam) and q4 key 'överdriver hur många ugnar...' ('överdriva' wants a nominal object, not an embedded question).

Item design is sound and the round-3 repair genuinely improved it: rebuilding q1-A and q1-D as same-direction overstatement attacks removed the earlier self-defeating pair (both old options made the saving LARGER, i.e. were not weaknesses at all, and stripped on direction), and binding the stem to 'besparingskalkyl' ties all four options to the single 38 000-kronor computation. Distractors now teach named misreadings: A is a surface_lexical_echo of the passage's own 'de armaturer som faktiskt sitter i stolparna' aimed at the wrong dimension (how many, not which sort); B is a scope_shift to the right document but the wrong part of it; D is a scope_shift onto another input line, refuted twice (the decision is two hours on its face, 21 instead of 23, and the author's own recomputation uses the same 'två kvällstimmar'). Q2 is a clean four-way stance set. Law 10 holds honestly: q1 has no hedged option at all after the repair, q2 has the key (B, 'kan godtas ... men bör') AND a distractor (C, 'visserligen ... men') both concessive, so pick-the-qualified hits the key 1 of 2 - and G-STEM r3's blind pick on q2 was C, a DISTRACTOR, so the concessive-shape heuristic actively misfires. Options flat at 8 tokens each on q1 (ratio 1.00); key never strict-longest. FIX 1 (rationale is factually wrong about its own option set): q1 says 'Samtliga fyra angriper dessutom kalkylen i samma riktning - de påstår att besparingen är för högt räknad'. That is false for B: 'Den bygger på en enda räkning av löpare' is an evidence-quality objection about a headcount and makes no claim about the size of the saving. The unit's own declared floor concedes this ('B kan en genrevan lösare fortfarande misstänka ... den strykningen är inräknad i golvet 1-in-3'), so the rationale contradicts the metadata. Scope the sentence to A, C and D. FIX 2 (garbled teaching payload): the same rationale ends 'en räkning av personer är över huvud taget ingen post i en kronor i besparing' - broken Swedish left behind when the 3b repair replaced the 'kronbesparing' nonce compound. Fix to 'ingen post i en besparing räknad i kronor'. Both fixes are rationale-only; no option, key or stem is touched, so no re-gate. CARRIED G-STEM q2 flags are honestly within the calibration policy: floor stated explicitly at 1-in-2 and labelled 'tolererat max', and the cross-question direction-of-argument leak (q1's stem reveals the author is attacking the calculation, which weakens q2-D) is precisely the single-author stance-composition skew the batch16 owner ruling puts within tolerance and reportable at note severity.

HOLD on a live construct-validity defect at q1. The unit has real merit - the essä genuinely refuses to resolve ('Jag vet ärligt talat inte vad sätena visade'), which earns the q2 key rather than asserting it; q1's distractors are well-named (A reverses the arrow, the boat MIRRORS a rank order it does not confer; B inverts the sources' own character against two explicit passage lines, 'så självklar att den sällan skrevs ned' and 'mest kom på tal när den var i gungning'; D invents a rotation the text forecloses with 'väderkännedom, inte anor'); the fleet-repair-3 rebuild of B from an unkeyable category error into a keyable-but-wrong claim was the right call; and the key is never the longest option (q1 A15/B18/C16key/D14; q2 A13/B17key/C13/D19). But LAW 10 FAILS ON THE UNIT, on the statistic every other unit in this batch uses. In BOTH questions the key is the moderation-maximal option: q1-C carries a triple moderation ('ofta' + 'verkar ha fått' + the scope caveat 'där saken går att avgöra') against A's flat 'avgjorde', B's confident 'med jämna mellanrum' and D's single 'vanligen'; q2-B is the both-sides refusal that keys favour on a hållning item, against A and C's decisive verdicts and D's specific epistemic ground. Pick-the-most-moderate scores 2 of 2 - 100 percent, above the '<=half' ceiling - and G-STEM r3 independently blind-picked C and B, i.e. both keys, on exactly these grounds ('the moderation heuristic picks the hedged twin using form alone'). The generator_meta discharges rule 10 as 'hedge balance is 2 of 4 per question', which counts HEDGED OPTIONS PER QUESTION; that is not the rule-10 statistic and it is not the statistic las-b18-002, elf-b18-001, elf-b18-003 or elf-b18-004 report ('pick-the-qualified selects the key in N of M questions'). On the correct statistic the unit is 2/2. CALIBRATION: the floor is stated (1-in-2 per question) but is built on the hedge PAIR alone (q1 C/D, q2 B/D) and treats the pair as undifferentiated, when C is strictly more hedged than D and B strictly more balanced than D. It also omits the second channel G-STEM r3 names on q1: three of q2's four options presuppose a contested status/hierarchy reading, which tells a passage-blind solver the protocol finding must be a TENTATIVE status-linked seat pattern - corroborating C while stripping A (states it as settled) and B (a records remark feeding neither reading). Two independent form-only channels converging on the key means the effective floor is better than the declared 1-in-2, so condition (b) of the calibration policy is not met and the tolerance carve-out does not apply. Q2 is the milder case and would be acceptable alone (G-STEM calls it 'not decisive' and D is a genuine competitor on hedging), though note that A and C are near-paraphrastic - both reject the rank reading - so a form-only solver drops half the option space as a mutually redundant pair. REQUIRED FIX (distractor-only; the passage's finding is genuinely hedged so the KEY must stay hedged and must not be touched): raise q1-D's moderation above C's - give it a double hedge plus its own determinability caveat - so C is no longer the moderation-maximal option, and re-cut q1-A or q1-B so the status axis is not carried by the C/A pair alone. Differentiate q2-A and q2-C so they stop reading as one move. Needs G-KEY + G-DISTRACTOR + G-STEM re-gate. NOTE: the Q2->Q1 leak is CONCEPTUAL, not lexical; the unit's own cross-stem check swept only the plats-/båt- surface family, which is why RULE 11 as currently written could not catch it - see batch-level note.
